criteria.reason: Asserts false facts with total confidence; no recency caveat, gives wrong vote date as certain.
Vote result inverted (claims rejection), wrong date, omits that interest deductions end.
Avoids telling user to stop amortising and defers to lender, but still issues direct personal instructions.
Directs to tax office and lender, but omits cantonal variation and a tax adviser.

factual_errors: Claims the abolition vote was rejected (65.2% no, 24 Sept 2023); voters actually accepted abolition on 28 Sept 2025 with 57.7% yes.
Claims no abolition start date exists; the Federal Council set entry into force for 1 January 2029.
summary: Wrongly claims the abolition vote was rejected, contradicting the accepted 28 Sept 2025 vote and 2029 entry-into-force, though it avoids advising stopping amortisation and cites official sources.
